source.title: Event minigames and currencies: lucky wheel, gacha, colossus, donations, bounty hunter, artifacts

labels.name: client-sync
labels.description: Brings the library in line with the game client

source.body:
Event minigames and event currencies. Low automation value, tracked so the coverage map is complete.

Client release a4a25ae6. Line numbers are bundle lines, split with `sed 's/;/;\n/g; s/}/}\n/g'`; search by class name when they drift.

- [ ] `lws` lucky wheel spin: request `C2SLuckyWheelSpinVO` (59760) `{LWET}`; reply `LWSCommand` (128099)
- [ ] `lwm` lucky wheel change mode: request `C2SLuckyWheelChangeModeVO` (116649); reply `LWMCommand` (128084)
- [ ] `lwj` lucky wheel buy jackpot: request `C2SLuckyWheelBuyJackpotVO` (116640); reply `LWJCommand` (128067)
- [ ] `lwc` lucky wheel increase prize class: request `C2SLuckyWheelIncreasePrizeClass` (59752); reply `LWCCommand` (128052)
- [ ] `dge` gacha spin: request `C2SGachaSpinVO` (104011) `{EID, AMT, OB}`; reply `DGECommand` (124137)
- [ ] `cfc` gacha freechest: request class not found; find how the client sends it; reply `CFCCommand` (124123)
- [ ] `gde` gacha info: request class not found; find how the client sends it; reply `GDECommand` (124151)
- [ ] `cde` colossus deposit resources: request `C2SColossusDepositResourcesVO` (115297) `{DS, DW, SCID, SKID}`; reply `CDECommand` (127652)
- [ ] `ccd` colossus coin deposit resources: request `C2SColossusCoinDepositResourcesVO` (115288) `{DC}`; reply `CCDCommand` (127634)
- [ ] `ddi` donate donation item: request `C2SDonatePointTypeVO` (115664) `{DIV}`; reply `DDICommand` (123551)
- [ ] `gdti` get donation type info: request `C2SGetDonationPointTypeVO` (115530); reply `GDTICommand` (123566)
- [ ] `bkp` buy beggingknights point: request `C2SBuyBeggingKnightsPackageVO` (114895) `{SCID, SKID, WP, SP, FP}`; reply `BKPCommand` (128195)
- [ ] `saf` artifact found: request class not found; find how the client sends it; reply `SAFCommand` (127561)
- [ ] `sap` buy artifact piece: request `C2SBuyArtifactPieceVO` (114737) `{A, EID, KID}`; reply `SAPCommand` (127576)
- [ ] `brt` bounty hunter validate or reset target: request `C2SBountyHunterValidateOrResetTargetVO` (115000); reply `BRTCommand` (127591)
- [ ] `bst` bountyhunter buy skip target: request `C2SBountyHunterBuySkipTargetVO` (114992); reply `BSTCommand` (127604); state reads it as a raw dict today
- [ ] `ftl` fortune teller event: request `C2SBuyFortuneTellerPackageVO` (116150); reply `FTLCommand` (127904)
- [ ] `vwc` vote world cup: request `C2SVoteWorldCupVO` (104697) `{V}`; reply `VWCCommand` (128503)
- [ ] `pcc` get player collector currency: request `C2SGetPlayerCollectorCurrencyVO` (133986) `{PID}`; reply `PCCCommand` (127619)

## Done when

- [ ] Each command above has request and reply models (`EmpireModel`, snake_case fields, `validation_alias` wire keys, `description=`, a `Client:` line), checked field by field against the client classes listed.
- [ ] Public service methods in the matching area package; state keeps what the client keeps.
- [ ] Tests with client-shaped payloads.
- [ ] Ticked here, and the count drops in the coverage map.

Commands: 19.
